W.note: Figma palette and selection-handle motif are a nice nod, but the starburst's CSS transform overrides its SVG translate so it sits clipped in the top-left corner, and the composition is otherwise a generic shape set.

X.note: Polished staggered assemble-and-scatter with overshoot, glow, and both themes, but the resting state reproduces the Figma logo's five-shape arrangement and colors almost exactly, which the brief rules out.

Y.note: Half-circle, quarter-wedge and rounded-square pieces with Figma hues, a staggered cubic in-out assemble-burst-return, and periodic colour blooms make it read as Figma's brand language without its logo; the full-viewport canvas gradients are a mild performance cost.

Z.note: Periodic sine-driven orbits and bounces loop cleanly and respect reduced motion, but five pastel primitives drifting on a gradient is a generic shape screensaver with little Figma energy.
